m831e-c1.text: Is the EMERGENCY STOP button engaged (pushed in)?

m831e-c1by.text: Fails to crank — EMERGENCY STOP disengaged. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Fails to crank — EMERGENCY STOP disengaged

m831e-c2.text: Is the START/RUN/STOP switch in the START position when cranking?

m831e-c2by.text: Fails to crank — START/RUN/STOP switch placed in START. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Fails to crank — START/RUN/STOP switch placed in START

m831e-c3.text: Is the DC CIRCUIT BREAKER tripped?

m831e-c3by.text: Fails to crank — DC CIRCUIT BREAKER reset. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Fails to crank — DC CIRCUIT BREAKER reset

m831e-c4.text: Check the malfunction indicator module. Is a system fault light lit?

m831e-c5.text: Are battery wires loose (not properly/securely connected)?

m831e-c5by.text: Fails to crank — battery connections tightened. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Fails to crank — battery connections tightened

m831e-c5t.text: Performing steps a-e does not yield results. Try Manual Starting (WP 0006). Does the engine start by hand?

m831e-ht1.text: Are the air inlet ducts clogged or obstructed?

m831e-ht1a.actionText: Clear restrictions and blockages. Press FAULT RESET pushbutton to reset fault indicator module.

m831e-ht1by.text: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — clear the air inlet ducts. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — clear the air inlet ducts

m831e-ht2.text: Is the air inlet grill on the recoil starter clogged or obstructed?

m831e-ht2a.text: Clear the recoil starter air inlet grill
m831e-ht2a.actionText: Clear restrictions and blockages. Press FAULT RESET pushbutton to reset fault indicator module.

m831e-ht2by.text: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — clear the recoil starter air inlet grill. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — clear the recoil starter air inlet grill

m831e-ht3a.actionText: Remove filter and inspect (WP 0011, Air Filter). Replace filter as required.

m831e-ht3by.text: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — service the air filter. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — service the air filter

m831e-ht4a.actionText: Reduce load. Press FAULT RESET pushbutton to reset fault indicator module.

m831e-ht4by.text: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — reduce the load. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — reduce the load

m831e-htz.text: Performing the listed steps does not yield results. Refer trouble to field level maintenance.

terminal.summary: ENGINE HIGH TEMP fault — not corrected by operator checks

m831e-lo1.text: Check engine oil level. Is servicing required?

m831e-lo1a.actionText: Service as required (WP 0001). (Oil check/add steps: WP 0010, Lubrication Instructions.) Press FAULT RESET pushbutton to reset fault indicator module.

m831e-lo1by.text: LOW OIL PRESSURE fault — service engine oil. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: LOW OIL PRESSURE fault — service engine oil

m831e-loz.text: Performing the listed steps does not yield results. Refer trouble to field level maintenance.

terminal.summary: LOW OIL PRESSURE fault — not corrected by operator checks

m831e-s1.text: Was the PREHEAT switch left in the wrong position for conditions (cold weather operation)?

m831e-s1by.text: Cranks but fails to start — set the preheat switch. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — set the preheat switch

m831e-s2.text: Is the mechanical governor speed control knob out of the START position or loose?

m831e-s2a.actionText: Adjust speed control knob and tighten (see WP 0006, Figure 1, Item 6).

m831e-s2by.text: Cranks but fails to start — set the speed control knob. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — set the speed control knob

m831e-s3.text: With START/RUN/STOP in RUN, does the governor actuator lever (WP 0006, Figure 1, Item 1) fail to release from the magnet?

m831e-s3a.text: Governor actuator lever does not release from magnet. Refer trouble to field level maintenance.

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — governor actuator lever does not release from magnet

m831e-s4.text: Is the fuel tank level low (WP 0011, Fuel System)?

m831e-s4a.actionText: Service fuel tank as required. Press FAULT RESET pushbutton to reset fault indicator module.

m831e-s4by.text: Cranks but fails to start — service the fuel tank. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — service the fuel tank

m831e-s5a.actionText: Place switch in ON position. Press FAULT RESET pushbutton to reset fault indicator module.

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — place aux fuel switch on

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — straighten flexible fuel lines

m831e-s7.text: Is there water in the fuel filter/water separator (WP 0011, Fuel Filter/Water Separator)?

m831e-s7a.actionText: Drain water from fuel filter/water separator by turning valve.

m831e-s7by.text: Cranks but fails to start — drain the fuel filter/water separator. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — drain the fuel filter/water separator

m831e-sz.text: Performing the listed steps does not yield results. Refer trouble to field level maintenance.

terminal.summary: Cranks but fails to start — not corrected by operator checks

m831e-r3.text: Are any fuel lines crimped or pinched?

m831e-nf1.text: Check fuel tank level (WP 0011, Fuel System). Is the tank low or empty?

m831e-nf1a.actionText: Service fuel tank as required. Press FAULT RESET pushbutton to reset fault indicator module.

m831e-nf1by.text: NO FUEL indicator — service the fuel tank. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: NO FUEL indicator — service the fuel tank

terminal.summary: Fails to start in cold weather — place preheat switch on

m831e-w2.text: Is improper fuel being used for cold weather operation?

m831e-w2a.actionText: Use proper fuel as noted on FUEL CAPACITY data plate (WP 0002, Figure 4, Sheet 3 of 7).

m831e-w3.text: Are any fuel lines crimped or pinched?

terminal.summary: Fails to start in cold weather — straighten flexible fuel lines

m831e-w4.text: Are there clogs or frozen water in the fuel lines or filter separator, or is a fuel line or the filter separator damaged?

m831e-x1.text: Move the actuator lever to the magnet
m831e-x1.actionText: Verify the actuator lever is touching the magnet; manually move the actuator lever to the magnet.

m831e-x2.text: Engine fails to stop with EMERGENCY STOP or STOP position. Notify field level maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fails to stop — needs field maintenance

m831e-c5n.text: Engine will not start electrically or manually. Refer trouble to field level maintenance.

m831x-w2.text: Is there water in the fuel filter/water separator?

m831x-k2.text: Has the engine run for prolonged periods at idle speed (no load)?
